subject: Request: Customer-scoped log retention waiver & mitigation assessment
messages:
From: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@medallionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary retention extension for customer logs (Medallion)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week. We have a short ask from our security and clinical engineering teams: for one of our production integrations (debug sessions tied to a regulated workflow), we need session/debug logs retained at the tenant level for 180 days instead of Redwood's standard 30-day TTL. This is a scoped request limited to a single tenant (Medallion-PROD).

We understand this is a deviation — Medallion can accept compensating controls and a restricted access model. Specifically, they propose:
- Role-based access: only two named engineers and one SOC contact can access the extended logs
- Access via VPN + customer-approved SSO (already in place)
- Audit logging of any access to those logs, exported weekly to Medallion's S3

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a temporary waiver (initially 6 months), what evidence you would need (SOC2/CAIQ mappings, exportable audit logs), and whether there are any platform changes required? I attached a short PDF describing their ask.

Thanks,
Alex Guerrero
Head of Platform Security
Medallion Health

Attachment: medallion_retention_ask_20261227.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention extension for customer logs (Medallion)

Alex —

Appreciate the note and clear mitigations. Looping in Ben from Sales (contract/terms) and Kimberly from Security/Compliance to scope the technical/evidence side. Quick answers up front:
- We can scope tenant-level retention beyond default for specific customers, but it requires an internal compliance review and a documented compensating-controls plan (RBAC, export/restrict, retention labels).
- We'll need a CAIQ/SIG mapping showing the control gaps and how they are mitigated, and an example of the audit export you expect.
- Any extension beyond 90 days may trigger an enterprise privacy review and an addendum to the customer agreement.

Ben/Kim — can you advise on the minimal evidence set we should provide to Medallion to move to legal/ops? My suggested next steps: 1) Kimberly drafts an evidence mapping + temporary policy; 2) Ben compiles contract addendum language and pricing for dedicated retention; 3) I coordinate a short 30-min call with Medallion to finalize.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention extension for customer logs (Medallion)

Alex / team —

From a commercial standpoint we can handle a scoped retention addendum. A few practical notes:
- We typically price tenant-scoped retention changes as a small monthly add-on (covers storage + retention verification).
- For a 6-month pilot at 180 days TTL, propose a time-limited SOW + a clause for automatic reversion to 30d unless renewed.
- We'll need a PO referencing the addendum once compliance signs off.

Kimberly — can your team produce a short artifact set (1 page control summary + CAIQ mapping) we can hand to Medallion? Also, if any red flags exist (e.g., cross-tenant exposure risk), call them out now.

Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Guerrero <alex.guerrero@medallionhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention extension for customer logs (Medallion)

Alex / Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the clear ask and proposed compensating controls. I've completed an initial assessment and attached a CAIQ mapping workbook that highlights controls impacted by a tenant-level retention longer than our standard policy and the compensating controls Redwood will implement. High-level summary:

1) Scope & isolation
- Impact: Increased exposure window for tenant-level debug traces.
- Mitigation: Tenant tagging + encryption at rest with customer KMS for that specific tenant; network egress rules to restrict exports to Medallion-approved destinations.

2) Access controls & auditability
- Impact: Longer-lived logs increase the need for strict access governance.
- Mitigation: Strict RBAC (two engineers + one SOC), mandatory VPN + SSO with MFA, and weekly automated audit exports to Medallion S3 (immutable retention).

3) Compliance artifacts requested
- CAIQ mapping (attached): lists controls, our baseline, and compensating controls.
- Example audit export schema: We'll provide a sanitized sample showing subject, timestamp, actor, action, and SHA256 hash.
- Proof of encryption and KMS policy snippet.

Constraints / notes:
- Any extended retention must be timeboxed and documented in an addendum signed by Legal. We will not change global defaults; this is tenant-scoped and reversible.
- Operationally, we can support a 6-month pilot starting after legal sign-off and a short runbook for emergency revocation.

Next steps I propose:
- I will upload the CAIQ mapping and a sample audit export to the shared Drive folder and share a DocuSign addendum draft (link below).
- Marissa/Ben: please confirm preferred start date for the pilot and the two engineer names who should be granted access.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_20261228.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-medallion-retention
